strings.name: Tony Blair
strings.summary: A barrister turned Labour politician, Blair led three election victories and served as prime minister in 1997–2007. He helped secure Northern Ireland’s peace agreement and public-service reforms, while the Iraq invasion remains central to criticism of his record. He later founded TBI and accepted a Board of Peace Executive Board appointment in 2026.
